paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy of different methods under various generation temperatures. The x-axis represents temperature on a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8) on a linear scale, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. There are three lines in the plot: the orange line representing On-policy RL, with triangular markers and a solid line style, starts at approximately 62.5 and ends at approximately 72.5, initially increasing then decreasing before rising again; the red line representing LUFFY, with star markers and a solid line style, starts at approximately 78.0 and ends at approximately 80.0, fluctuating; and the blue line representing SFT, with circular markers and a solid line style, starts at approximately 76.5 and ends at approximately 74.0, generally decreasing then increasing.
